recognize_zh: 中央一顆大細胞有兩個相鄰的空泡狀核，各帶明顯的嗜伊紅／深紫色大核仁（macronucleolus），周圍有空白收縮暈，背景是小淋巴球、組織球與嗜酸性球的混合發炎細胞，典型的 Reed-Sternberg 細胞。
features: Very large binucleate cell with two closely apposed, mirror-image oval nuclei
Vesicular, open chromatin with thick nuclear membranes
Prominent inclusion-like macronucleolus in the upper nucleus and a smaller central nucleolus in the lower nucleus
Abundant pale cytoplasm with a surrounding clear retraction space
Mixed inflammatory background of small lymphocytes, histiocytes/larger vesicular cells and an eosinophil at the right
describe_en: Section of a lymphoid tissue (likely lymph node) at high power shows a very large binucleate cell with two apposed oval nuclei, vesicular chromatin, thick nuclear membranes and a prominent eosinophilic to purple macronucleolus, surrounded by abundant pale cytoplasm and a retraction space. The background is a polymorphous infiltrate of small lymphocytes, histiocytes and occasional eosinophils. No sheets of large atypical cells are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with a Reed-Sternberg cell and suggestive of classic Hodgkin lymphoma; confirmation by immunohistochemistry (CD30+, CD15+, PAX5 weak, CD45-) is recommended.

ddx.vs: ALCL shows sheets of cohesive hallmark cells with horseshoe nuclei, CD30 strong but PAX5 negative, often ALK or T-cell antigen positive.
Immunoblasts are smaller mononuclear cells with a single central nucleolus, CD45+ and strong PAX5/CD20 or T-cell markers, lacking bilobed mirror-image nuclei.
LP cells have multilobated popcorn nuclei with small nucleoli and are CD20+, CD45+, CD30-/CD15-.
